 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The fast-paced Hong Kong Sixes six-a-side cricket tournament's 2026 edition takes place from October 30 to November 1 at Tin Kwong Road Recreation Ground, Kowloon, Hong Kong.
 The 12 participating teams include India and defending champions Pakistan, with a history of substantial prizes offered at previous events.

 While the organisers have announced details of the 2026 competition, an official prize-money breakdown for this edition has not been published.
 Based on the amounts from earlier events, and until a confirmation on the prize money for the 2026 edition is available, The Sporting News combines is the available data on the prize money below.
 Add The Sporting News as a preferred news source 
 How much is Hong Kong Sixes 2026 prize money?
 The official figure for the 2026 edition is yet to be revealed.
 At the 2025 tournament, Pakistan received US$20,000 for winning the competition, while runners-up Kuwait took home US$15,000.

 Who won Hong Kong Sixes 2025?
 In 2025, Pakistan were the champions of the Hong Kong Sixes tournament after beating Kuwait by 43 runs in the finals.
 When will Hong Kong Sixes 2026 take place?
 Hong Kong Sixes 2026 runs from October 30 to November 1, 2026, at the Tin Kwong Road Recreation Ground in Kowloon.
